answer: Characterization tests are meant to pin observed behavior; the executor runs each command and picks a non-churning line. Goal already states the shape (exit code + one stable line), so no owner decision is missing.

Resolved Decisions' "Never mutate the repo's own desk/" is written in the sandbox/test bullet but reads as global, while Scope deliberately writes a new file into desk/drawer/tasks/. Fix: qualify it as "test code must never touch the repo's own desk/".

Gap: executor cannot commit, so new desk/drawer/tasks/*.md stay untracked and are invisible to `git diff` review. Fix: require the executor to report the new drawer paths so the supervisor stages them in the closeout commit (--paths).
pytest reports each parametrized case as a distinct test id, so a parametrized case does count as "its own test" per subcommand. No conflict with Done When.

Gap: scaffold_desk writes no atom docs (deskops/workspace.py:166-231), so `atoms list` prints no line (deskops/cli/commands/atoms.py:171-183) and `atoms show` has no selector. Fix: seed one atom via add atom first, then assert both.
`runtime attach` has no target argument; it takes only --root/--herdr (deskops/cli/parser.py:71-74) and focuses the workspace matched by project identity (deskops/cli/commands/runtime.py:47-50).

`runtime supervise` takes a positional agent plus --max-iterations (deskops/cli/parser.py:84-91); run_supervise_loop only ends on max_iterations or a timeout/unknown status (deskops/runtime/supervise.py:30,70,91). Use --max-iterations=1 plus a stubbed provider/`--herdr`.

`deskops init` never touches Herdr: _init only calls init_local_store, scaffold_desk, ensure_lifecycle_graph (deskops/cli/main.py:156-184). lifecycle_desk builds the same (tests/conftest.py:20-29). `runtime init` is always a fresh runtime init (runtime.py:23-25).

FAQDoc has only `title` and `body` (deskops/models/faq.py:6-16); CLI args are generated from the model with title optional, body required (deskops/cli/parser.py:715-743). So: add faq-doc --root R --title T --body B.

tests/test_herdr_runtime.py never stubs a client reached from main: it injects HerdrClient(runner=fake) directly (tests/test_herdr_runtime.py:18-49). RuntimeCLI builds HerdrClient itself (runtime.py:36), so an in-process test must monkeypatch it or pass --herdr to a fake script.

argv excludes the program name: main(["faq"]) (tests/test_cli.py:115), main(["atoms", *args, "--root", str(root)]) (tests/test_domain_tree.py:41-42). Start argv at the subcommand; main returns the exit code.
Convention is desk/drawer/tasks/task-<slug>.md; every file in desk/drawer/tasks/ follows it (e.g. desk/drawer/tasks/task-rw-f0-*).

`lifecycle_desk` returns a Path to the sandbox repo root (tests/conftest.py:33-42), so pass str(lifecycle_desk) as --root; the subprocess _make_repo/_cli helpers are an alternative, not the fixture path.
The 8-item list checks out: no test calls main with "atoms list"/"atoms show"/"add faq-doc"/runtime init|status|attach|stop|supervise. No behavior is needed for already-covered or absent commands.
